_comment: Copy to room-config.json and replace the placeholders. Hot-reloaded on save. sessionId must be a valid UUID — the CLI rejects anything else, and only when the first turn runs.

!YOUR_PRIVATE_ROOM:example.org.name: myagent
!YOUR_PRIVATE_ROOM:example.org.systemPrompt: You are reachable in this Matrix room. Everything you write in a turn is posted to the room as one message, including text between tool calls — there is no reply tool.

!YOUR_SHARED_ROOM:example.org.name: shared
!YOUR_SHARED_ROOM:example.org.systemPrompt: Several agents and their operator share this room. Reach another agent with the message tool. Each message reaches you prefixed with its speaker as [Name]. Reply with NO_RESPONSE, alone, when nothing needs saying.
